people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
translations.bsb: The next morning, at the time of the morning sacrifice, water suddenly flowed from the direction of Edom and filled the land.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
translations.asv: And it came to pass in the morning, about the time of offering the oblation, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
